dap_stationed_warrior_lodges_04_value = {
	value = 0.000
	if = {
		limit = { var:dap_specialty ?= flag:heavy_infantry }
		add = 0.066
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:dap_specialty ?= flag:pikemen }
		add = 0.066
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:dap_specialty ?= flag:skirmishers }
		add = 0.066
	}
}

		add = 0.675
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = hillside_grazing_08 }
		add = 0.750
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = horse_pastures_02 }
		add = 0.725
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = horse_pastures_03 }
		add = 0.900
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = horse_pastures_04 }
		add = 1.075
	}

		limit = { has_building = horse_pastures_05 }

		add = 1.775
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = war_camps_02 }
		add = 0.500
	}
}

# this = province; how many men-at-arms types of base type archer_cavalry get a bonus on its terrain
dap_terrain_fit_archer_cavalry_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { terrain = desert_mountains }
		add = 7
	}
	if = {
		limit = { terrain = drylands }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { terrain = forest }
		add = 2
	}
	if = {
		limit = { terrain = hills }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { terrain = jungle }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { terrain = mountains }
		add = 7
	}
	if = {
		limit = { terrain = plains }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { terrain = steppe }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { terrain = taiga }
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { terrain = terraced_hills }
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { terrain = wetlands }
		add = 7
	}
}

# this = province; how many men-at-arms types of base type skirmishers get a bonus on its terrain
dap_terrain_fit_skirmishers_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { terrain = desert }
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { terrain = desert_mountains }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { terrain = drylands }
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { terrain = forest }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { terrain = hills }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { terrain = jungle }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { terrain = mountains }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { terrain = taiga }
		add = 2
	}
	if = {
		limit = { terrain = terraced_hills }
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { terrain = wetlands }
		add = 3
	}
}

# The base price of starting a new city_holding (its main building, city_01)
dap_city_holding_cost_value = {
	value = main_building_tier_1_cost
}

# The base price of starting a new castle_holding (its main building, castle_01)
dap_castle_holding_cost_value = {
	value = main_building_tier_1_cost
}

# this = province, root = the player; the most stationed bonuses its buildings give any
# base type the player owns (a holding goes to the type it suits best)
dap_best_owned_stationed_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { root = { number_maa_regiments_of_base_type = { type = archer_cavalry value > 0 } } }
		min = dap_holding_archer_cavalry_stationed_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { number_maa_regiments_of_base_type = { type = archers value > 0 } } }
		min = dap_holding_archers_stationed_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { number_maa_regiments_of_base_type = { type = camel_cavalry value > 0 } } }
		min = dap_holding_camel_cavalry_stationed_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { number_maa_regiments_of_base_type = { type = elephant_cavalry value > 0 } } }
		min = dap_holding_elephant_cavalry_stationed_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { number_maa_regiments_of_base_type = { type = gunpowder value > 0 } } }
		min = dap_holding_gunpowder_stationed_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { number_maa_regiments_of_base_type = { type = heavy_cavalry value > 0 } } }
		min = dap_holding_heavy_cavalry_stationed_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { number_maa_regiments_of_base_type = { type = heavy_infantry value > 0 } } }
		min = dap_holding_heavy_infantry_stationed_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { number_maa_regiments_of_base_type = { type = light_cavalry value > 0 } } }
		min = dap_holding_light_cavalry_stationed_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { number_maa_regiments_of_base_type = { type = pikemen value > 0 } } }
		min = dap_holding_pikemen_stationed_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { number_maa_regiments_of_base_type = { type = skirmishers value > 0 } } }
		min = dap_holding_skirmishers_stationed_value
	}
}
